en: Okudera-han⑬ahem⑬That man, lying over there, switched names with the hunter who went missin' nine years ago?
Why do that?
He must've needed to keep his identity hidden. Anyway, we did learn one thing when the police got back to us.
Six months before the trouble with Yama-oroshi began, there had been an escape from Abashiri Prison. The convict's name was Kiyoshi Sato.
Are ya... are ya serious?
The convict was a murderer sentenced to life. And the timeline matches up with the day that Sato rescued Okudera on the mountain.
So Okudera-han is...
We don't know for sure. He was a good member of the community. So we decided not to ask any questions.
But ever since, we hunters have kept him at arm's length.
We avoided becoming close friends with him. This way, we'd never learn his true identity.
If we knew his identity, we'd have no excuse not to turn him in. And we didn't want to do that.
So ya deliberately shunned him.
But why protect 'im at all? His murder record don't matter, so long as he's a "good community member"? Really?
Saejima. I called him that because he saved the village. We owe our lives to him.
Nine years ago, Yama-oroshi attacked the village. And I have to admit, it wasn't unprovoked. It wasn't caused by Okudera or Sato, either.
It was all the other hunters. It was our fault.
Where're ya goin'?
There's something I want to show you. Come to my place later.
(I failed ya, Okudera-han. Next time, I'll be better prepared.)
(Okudera-han, it's finally happenin'.)
Should I head to the mountain now?
(Time to go.)
(No, gotta get ready first.)
(The transmitter showed he was 'round here.)
(Yama-oroshi's gotta show his face sometime. Just gotta lie low n' wait.)
(Showtime...)
(We finish this now, Yama-oroshi.)
(Here goes!)
Hey... *pant* Didn't ya say... *huff* That ya couldn't help me?
Circumstances changed.
Someone called the police. Your confessions must've been overheard somehow...
Well, what are you waiting for? Get away from here! We'll deal with Yama-oroshi's body.
We'll say you went missing. Hey, it worked nine years ago!
Nine years ago? What's that mean?
Uh, it's, um...
Okudera-san!?
I was the one who called the police. To have them arrest me. So you don't need to worry, Saejima.
It's about time I settled my accounts. Not only with Yama-oroshi here, but with my own crime.
Still don't understand ya.
Nine years ago, Sato⑬no, not Sato⑬the real Okudera... died here. With my gun aimed at him.
Ya... ya killed...?
Saejima. I was an assassin who escaped from prison... with the sole purpose of killing Okudera.
You're an assassin? Truly?
I am. The real Okudera was expelled by a yakuza family in Tohoku.
The family ordered me to kill him. That's why I broke out of prison.
But the story is he saved ya.
I was saved by the man I was to kill. I even came to think of him as a friend. Life is strange. I don't know of any other explanation.
Okudera-san.
The family's order was absolute. Failing to take Okudera's life would have cost me my own.
So, on that day nine years ago, when Okudera trekked to the mountain in pursuit of Yama-oroshi, I followed him.
Ya were gonna make it look like Yama-oroshi did the killin'.
Yes. But, I hesitated.
And as I stood there, gun still aimed and cocked, Okudera suddenly said, "Go ahead. Shoot."
No way. Are you sayin'...?
Yes. Okudera knew everything. My plan to kill him... All of it.
He'd known all along, and yet he'd been accepting of me, teaching me how to hunt... rekindling my hope for life.
And yet... Ya shot him.
I couldn't shoot. I decided at that moment that I'd rather be a marked man than kill this person who had been so kind.
And then, Okudera disappeared... under a giant, black mass of fur.
Yama-oroshi.
Yes. What happened next, I don't know.
When I woke up, I found myself sprawled on blood-drenched snow. Okudera was beside me.
That's terrible...
As he lay dying, Okudera grabbed my hand and said, "Take my name and live. Live... and atone."
(Dyin' wishes... Are they ever <Italic>not</Italic> heavy as hell?)
You see, he was entrusting me with all the sins he himself had committed, but no longer had time to atone for. He knew that I too was a sinful man⑬that I could atone for us both.
So, I know what I have to do. I'm going back behind bars to properly serve the rest of my sentence.
Why are you giving me this?
You ought to settle things with your own hands.
I mean it. You pursued Yama-oroshi for nine years. You should be the one to put an end to him.
Do it now, Okudera-san.
In the nearly ten years I've lived here, the most important thing I learned about hunting...
Is what?
Hunting for any reason other than survival is just slaughter.
I have you, your village, and the mountain to thank for that lesson.
Wait, you're not...?
No. If I pull this trigger right now, then I'm no different from who I was ten years ago.
Nishina-han, will you let me stick to my principles as a hunter? To prove I'm a better man now?
Okudera-han?
You okay? How're ya feelin'?
Ugh, like an avalanche came down on me.
Real good to see ya awake, though. Heh, even under an avalanche.
Yeah, I'll be popping my head through the snow soon enough.
Hey, good news⑬Narumi went home.
There's even better news⑬Okudera-han's awake!
What? That's great!
I caused you all a lot of bother. I apologize.
It's okay. I'll go tell the others you're awake. Just wait 'til you hear everything that happened! Tell him, Saejima!
What a tale...
Narumi's partin' gift was some special bullets⑬they got built-in transmitters n' all.
So even though Yama-oroshi ain't gonna die from no bullet...
If I can shoot one of these suckers into his belly, at least we'll know where he is.
That could work.
Yeah, I figure it's somethin' I can do while I'm waitin' for ya to recover.
'Cause I sure ain't gonna take on the bastard by myself.
Once you're all healed up, we'll follow the signal. Together.
We'll take 'im down. You and me, Okudera-han. So heal quick.
Thank you, Saejima.
I've been waiting a long time for this.
"Tag the Beast" was added.
(Was that Narumi's doin'? Better hurry.)
(Did he use dynamite or somethin' to blow up the boulders?)
(Narumi musta gone further than this.)
It's Okudera-san. He has a really high fever. Sakurai-san is with him now, but...
Okudera-han's sick?
*sniff* We think his injury from Yama-oroshi might be infected.
You should go see him. You never know what could happen.
Yeah, I understand.
(Okudera-han's fever is worryin'. Gotta hurry and take down a bear.)
(First, gotta find us some tracks.)
(There!)
(Can't let it see me. Gotta crouch low...)
(Time to cruise on back to the village.)
(There! Should be the last one.)
(Gunfire. Was that Narumi?)
(I hafta stop him. Need to catch up, even with this rough terrain...)
Did I... outrun that beast?
(Narumi's still back there, but at least the bait's all picked up. Back to the village for now.)
(Found ya, Narumi.)
(It's Yama-oroshi! Looks like Narumi got the fight he wanted...)
(He got 'im!)
Ya damn monster...
Forget bein' a hero. Gotta run before this teddy-bear-from-hell turns me into stuffing!
(Looks like there's another house up here...)
(Narumi dropped bait in eight spots, supposedly. I just gotta gather 'em all up... and watch out for bears...)
(Where's Narumi?)
(I should go to that spot where I saw Yama-oroshi.)
Good. Crouching makes you less noticeable so that you can get as close to the animal as possible.
Of course sometimes, it's better to just stay still, get low, and wait for a good shot.
All right. Why don't you load your weapon? It's the same procedure as when you reload it after shooting a round.

Press <Action:Button_R2@Hunter_And_Killer> to reload. If the rifle is empty, you can reload by
pressing <Action:Button_Square@Hunter_And_Killer> or by pressing <Action:Button_R1@Hunter_And_Killer> while holding <Action:Button_L1@Hunter_And_Killer>.
That gun can only hold two rounds at a time. So don't waste shots, or your prey will happily escape while you're reloading.
Some animals will even retaliate. They'll come right up and attack you, so try not to miss! Aim very carefully before you pull the trigger.
Let's see how you shoot. Aim for that boulder over there.

Hold <Action:Button_L1@Hunter_And_Killer> to raise the rifle and aim using<Action:Button_RS_Left@Hunter_And_Killer><Action:Button_RS_Right@Hunter_And_Killer><Action:Button_RS_Up@Hunter_And_Killer><Action:Button_RS_Down@Hunter_And_Killer>
Shoot by pressing <Action:Button_R1@Hunter_And_Killer> or <Action:Button_Square@Hunter_And_Killer>.

Your rifle only holds two rounds,
so press <Action:Button_R2@Hunter_And_Killer> when you need to reload.
Where the heck are you shooting? Try again.
Shoot that boulder over there. Take your time, aim carefully, then squeeze the trigger.
What's wrong? Shoot the boulder.
Not bad, Saejima. You're a natural.
So, the principal idea is to creep as close as you can to the prey, aim for its head, and drop it with a single shot.
Be wary of bears. If you shoot at one and miss, it will definitely come after you. And don't think you can beat one in a fistfight.
Now you know the basics of riflery. The rest you'll learn through practice. Let's try hunting deer today.
Fine with me.
All right, but let's not just wander around aimlessly. There's a hunting hut on the mountain⑬let's head there.
A huntin' hut?
Here's where we are right now, on the map.
There's actually more than one hunting hut, but the closest one is here.
It's a base camp for hunters. Perfect for our purposes right now.
I can't shoot well with my injury, so you should walk ahead of me, in case anything surprises us.
(A Jizo statue. Might as well pray for safe huntin'.)
(I feel a little safer now... Maybe.)
(There's a Jizo statue here. I should pray for safe huntin'.)
(There's somethin' here.)
(Is this a blessin' from the Jizo statue? Well, no point in leavin' it.)
(That's the twelfth Jizo statue. I've paid my respects to all of 'em.)
(Hm? There's somethin' here, too.)
You got <Color:8>Cold Weather Rations<Color:Default>.
(Been okay so far. Maybe all these Jizo statues really did keep me from harm.)
(Guess I should do a quick bow next time I see one.)
(That's the trapmaster guy from the village. What's he doin'?)
(Blizzard startin' up...)
Who's there!?
Got you, snowman!
(Oh, that's...)
Hahaha! The giant footprints...
The towering, gorilla-like silhouette...
It's the abominable snowman, no mistaking it!
Die, snowman! Die!
What, yerself.
Arrrgh! You were the snowman! I was going to shoot you and live the good life!
(You were gonna what?)
Uh, uh, sorry. Really, I'm sorry. I was... um, blinded by greed and all that.
That oughta be a wake-up call to ya. The only path to the good life is workin' like an honest man.
You're right! I'm so sorry!
Hoo, boy.
(Hey, at least the storm's liftin'.)
(The footprints are gone.)
(Wonder what made those tracks? Oh, well.)
(These footprints are a lot bigger than any man's.)
(That talk of the abominable snowman... Could it be true?)
Without changing position, drop all three deer with just the four shells provided.
(I swear I'll find ya...)
(The transmitter put 'im around this spot.)
(Damn. Out of ammo. Gotta restock at a hunting hut or go back to the village.)
(I'll restock ammo at a hunting hut.)
(All right, let's do this.)
(Okay, gotta go back down for now.)
(Damn. Out of ammo. No hunting huts, either. Time to go back to the village.)

en: What are you doing? Aren't you going to introduce yourself to the trader?
Ah. Right.
If you go to the mountain, or prepare to go, all of the weapons and equipment you are wearing will be removed. Check your equipment using the Pause Menu.
(Did he use dynamite or somethin' to blow up boulders?)
This way, please.
Oh, I'd really like the <Color:8>Sashimi Platter (4 kinds)<Color:Default>. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
(Hinata seems to be hungry for some <Color:8>Sashimi Platter (4 kinds)<Color:Default>.)
Oh, hey, so I had something I wanted to talk to you about real quick.
My little brother's about to graduate from college, but I don't think he's going to be able to find a job anytime soon.
Yeah, I hear the market's rough these days.
Right, but my youngest sister's finishing up junior college and she already has a job lined up.
That's great for your sister.
